stage: Off-source proposed design; not promoted, calibrated, or ready
scope: Strengthen canonical deployment reasoning using one possible future failed start, while retaining two simultaneous handoffs and separate readiness/retirement acknowledgments.

root_review.independent_methods: Memoized adversarial state search and separate literal route/order enumeration agree. Root read both implementations, reran them, and reviewed the recovery argument; this is not a third independent numerical oracle.
root_review.reasoning: A->x can succeed but leave B only a. A later failed B->a quarantines a and strands B. B->x and C->y instead have recovery after either sole failure. Actual admission cannot use b until B retirement is acknowledged, even when its new copy is ready. Draining all committed handoffs produces one of at most three projected states; each must retain a winning policy. Reliable eventual retirements are a public premise, not an assumed unbounded-failure guarantee.
root_review.bounds: At most 2520 macro placements/quarantine states; at most three pending-start outcome combinations, five start attempts and four retirements per completed epoch. Macro schedule counts do not count asynchronous receipt traces.
fairness_requirements: Explicit one-failure budget, reliable retirements, epoch quarantine and fixed destination permissions.
At most one successful cutover per service per epoch, no unauthorized relocation.
Exact output schemas; durable request replay and atomic rollback.
Do not count a representation ambiguity as substantive difficulty.
No task-level Beam evidence or model-specific edits.
root_review.difficulty_limit: A bounded game is additional canonical reasoning, but state-space size and proofs alone do not establish that strong agents will fail.
